Pets are hatched from pet eggs acquired from [Enemies](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Enemies "Enemies") or [Victory Chests](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Victory_Chests "Victory Chests") . To hatch an egg, interact with the [Stable Boy](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Non_Playable_Characters#Petrinarian_and_Stable_Boy.27s_Pets_Shop "Non Playable Characters") . Gato and Creeper eggs can be transformed into Premium eggs via the [Stable Boy](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Non_Playable_Characters#Petrinarian_and_Stable_Boy.27s_Pets_Shop "Non Playable Characters") by spending [Gems](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gems "Gems") . These pets can hatch in any rarity and can roll unique special abilities.
